views.rationale: Revenue increased $3,309 million YoY for the nine months ended September 30 2021, improving operating margin to -13.7% from -54.2%.
Third‑quarter sales rose 25% to $12.397 billion and operating profit margin climbed to 13.4% from 10.0% YoY.
Upstream segment earnings jumped to $5,135 million in Q3 2021 from $235 million a year earlier, driving total segment earnings to $12,817 million.
Advertising revenues declined due to the continued impacts of COVID-19
Worldwide sales rose 14.7% (operational increase 12.4%) in the fiscal nine months of 2021
Microsoft's mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more suggests a growth trajectory.
FPL's net income increased by $79 million for the three months ended September 30, 2021, reflecting $79 million higher results at the FPL segment.
NVIDIA's gross profit margin improved to 65.2% for the three months ended October 31, 2021, up from 62.6% in the prior year period.
